sentimento.text1: The presidential book totals USD 131.76M and the price on this page comes from the confirmed reading of Aug 23, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC). Lula is at 62.50% (vol USD 8.89M) and Flávio Bolsonaro at 33.25% (vol USD 8.79M), with the distance between the two at 29.25pp.
sentimento.text2: The day had no price movement, and that is what sets it apart. Lula closed with no change at all and Flávio Bolsonaro gave up 0.10pp. The only one who moved was Renan Santos, from 2.65% to 3.45%, and the rise gives back the fall recorded yesterday rather than opening a new one.
sentimento.text3: No upward superlative applies today. The peak of Lula's full series is 70.00%, from April 28, and Flávio Bolsonaro's is 45.50%, from May 6. Both sit well below their own maximums, and today's price is not extreme in either direction.
sentimento.direita: Flávio Bolsonaro at 33.25% in the presidential market and 86.50% in the first-round second-place contract. The Liberal Party has 78.50% in the market for the largest Senate caucus.
sentimento.esquerda: Lula at 62.50%, unchanged on the day. In the first-round second-place contract he appears at 6.35%, which is consistent with a market that sees him finishing first.
sentimento.terceiraVia: Renan Santos at 3.45% after recovering 0.80pp, and Ronaldo Caiado at 0.55%. In the first-round third-place contract the two are separated by 15.00pp, at 56.00% against 41.00%.
sentimento.polymarket: Prices from the confirmed reading of Aug 23, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC). AFOS only publishes a price that two independent readings, eight minutes apart, confirm within 0.20pp. The guard proves the price is not in transit; it does not prove the price is the level of the day.

inss.text1: ⭐ NEW DEVELOPMENT ON Aug 20, AND IT COMES FROM THE PROSECUTION. The Prosecutor General's Office stated that the man known as the "Careca do INSS" did not close deals with the Lula government and pointed to imprecision in a Federal Police conclusion, according to Estadão, in a petition sent to Justice André Mendonça.
inss.text2: On the same day the case became litigation between the two sides of the race: Fábio Luís Lula da Silva sued Flávio Bolsonaro and sought damages over a video made with artificial intelligence about suspected diversions, according to O Globo, Aug 20. Earlier on Aug 20, Flávio cited the case and treated the Dark Horse episode as a closed chapter, according to Folha.
inss.text3: The distinction this panel has kept from the start still holds: the effect on how the administration is rated is one thing, the effect on voting intention is another. ⛔ The panel does NOT attribute the 6.40pp narrowing over four days to the case, because no measurement isolates that.
inss.text4: NEW TENSION ON Aug 23, and it points in the opposite direction from the prosecutor general's office. The day's coverage carries the claim of an associate who says he heard the man known as the INSS Careca mention commitments and amounts involving Fábio Luís Lula da Silva and a lobbyist. It is a claim attributed to a source, reported by fewer outlets than the Aug 20 statement by the prosecutor general's office, and the panel records it as a claim, not as established fact.
inss.impactoLula: Not isolable, and now with two measurements from the same day that disagree: the Datafolha puts him at 39% in the first round with a 7 point lead, and the Veritá at 39.3% with 0.2 point. ⛔ Neither isolates the effect of the case, and the panel does not attribute the price move to it.
inss.impactoGestao: The rating still carries a negative balance: 42% poor or very poor against 34% excellent or good in the BTG/Nexus of Aug 17 (n=2,003, field Aug 14 to 16, TSE registration BR-03317/2026), a distance of 8 points. The panel records the balance and does not project an electoral effect from it.
inss.conclusao: The case still has no judicial outcome and now has both directions documented: on Aug 20 the prosecutor general's office contested part of the federal police's conclusion, and on Aug 23 coverage brings a claim in the opposite sense. The panel does not arbitrate between the two; it records that both exist and with what backing each one comes.

bancoMaster.text1: ⭐ THE NEW DEVELOPMENT ON Aug 20 IS ABOUT A PLEA DEAL. Investigators are willing to reopen negotiations with Daniel Vorcaro, but demand a complete plea agreement and a precise listing of assets held abroad, according to Folha de S.Paulo.
bancoMaster.text2: On the same day his defence asked to postpone his testimony to the Federal Police, citing a new lawyer joining the team, according to O Globo. ⚠️ The case also entered the campaign by another route: Justice André Mendonça, at the TSE, ordered the removal of a video made with artificial intelligence linking Flávio Bolsonaro to Vorcaro, and recorded that satire does not lift the prohibition. Reported independently by O Globo and G1, both on Aug 20.
bancoMaster.text3: ⚠️ The panel keeps the two things apart on purpose. Negotiating a plea deal is an investigative step and is not a conviction, and the case remains without a judicial outcome. Removing the video is an electoral ruling about campaign advertising, not a judgment on the merits of the banking case.
bancoMaster.conclusao: On Aug 23 the case resurfaces through an institutional effect, not an investigative act: the day's coverage records that developments in the Master and Lulinha cases widened the disagreement between Justice André Mendonça and the prosecutor general. It remains without a judicial outcome.

stf.toffoli: No individual act captured on Aug 23.
stf.moraes: He appears in the Aug 23 coverage, not in a new act: the day's stories discuss the reach of his decisions, with no new ruling recorded.
stf.dino: THE ACT OF THE DAY IS HIS. Flávio Dino ruled that parliamentary amendments directed by party presidents without a mandate are null, and warned of penalties for non-compliance, naming Podemos and Solidariedade. The decision was reported by eight distinct outlets in today's collection.
stf.mendonca: He appears on Aug 23 in an institutional disagreement: coverage records that developments in the Master and Lulinha cases widened the differences between him and the prosecutor general.
stf.nexo: THE LINK ON Aug 23 IS BUDGETARY, not electoral. Dino's decision on amendments touches the machinery that funds a parliamentary base in an election year, and it is the only Supreme Court decision with a direct and immediate campaign effect recorded on the day.
stf.analise: The contract on a Supreme Court justice leaving by impeachment before 2027 stands at 3.35% (vol USD 84 thousand), unchanged from yesterday, in the confirmed reading of Aug 23, 2:58 PM BRT (5:58 PM UTC). The market has not repriced Dino's decision on amendments.
